node.title: Re^2: Why don't *glob assignments affect the current pacakge?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I have a vague recollection that it is a long-standing deliberate exception - possibly a hack to help Exporter work, though I'm not confident of that.

The "documentation" I always refer to is [tye]'s [id://522234|node here] (and see my reply to that node).
